name: Curse of Strahd
blurb: A band of adventurers followed two children into a house in the fog and found themselves trapped in Barovia. Their search for a way out took them through haunted ruins, uneasy alliances, and the occasional argument over what counted as dinner.
highlights: A sling stone hatched into Tuulikki the drake.
Hrulek summoned Trevor the war camel.
The party put on a circus in Vallaki and filled the seats with two natural 20s.

name: Ballrooms & Barnacles
blurb: Set in the Iron Sun archipelago, this one-shot takes place aboard High Roller Reef, a floating casino-palace. The premise is a heist.
